size.value: 4 cm x 4 cm (foto tipo carné, for the physical consular file; the photo embedded in the passport itself is captured on-site at the appointment)

db_conflicts.research_value: 4cm x 4cm, per the Paraguayan Ministry of Foreign Affairs' consular passport service page (Consulate General in Buenos Aires)

cross_verification.note_en: Paraguay's domestic passport authority (Policia Nacional - Departamento de Identificaciones, identificaciones.gov.py / policianacional.gov.py) was directly checked but its passport pages did not state explicit photo dimensions, background, or other photo specs. The only official, directly-verified photo spec found was on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' consular portal (mre.gov.py subdomain, for Paraguayans applying at the Buenos Aires consulate): '1 (una) foto tipo carne, tamano 4 cm x 4 cm, color, fondo blanco, actualizada' - this is for the physical consular file; the actual passport photo is captured biometrically at the appointment. Domestic (non-consular) passport photo specs remain unverified.
